responsibility: Implements GCC’s classic human-readable diagnostics output format. This file defines the diagnostic_text_output_format behavior for formatting and flushing messages through pretty_printer, printing prefixes, locations, option/cwe/rule annotations, source diagrams, include and module stacks, and buffering support via a text-specific diagnostic_per_format_buffer, making it the main text-emission backend consumed by the language-independent diagnostic engine.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the diagnostic-format-text pair: unlike gcc/diagnostic-format-text.h, which declares diagnostic_text_output_format and its interface/state, this file defines the text backend’s behavior such as reporting, buffering, prefix/location printing, include/module stack emission, option/rule annotation printing, and final flushing through pretty_printer.
